Maria Chen: quick follow-up to the rollout metadata RFC — I'm proposing we add two fields: `cohort_label` (string) and a richer `soft_pin` object for non-blocking pin semantics. Thoughts? https://redwood/rfcs/rollout-metadata
AJ Patel: can you paste a minimal example of the manifest you have in mind?
Maria Chen: sure, minimal example:
```json
{
  "model_id": "ocp-7b-v2",
  "cohort_label": "canary-42",
  "rollout_metadata_version": "v1",
  "soft_pin": {
    "type": "soft",
    "priority": 0.8,
    "grace_seconds": 600,
    "expiry": "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z"
  },
  "compat_hints": ["kv-cache-friendly", "no-quantize"],
  "telemetry_tag": "cohort/canary-42"
}
```
Samir Gupta: two quick concerns: 1) pins table scan — we need a tenant+cohort index so lookups are O(1) for routing. 2) storage bloat from long-lived cohorts with heavy metadata arrays. Prefer keeping fields optional and small.
Leo Park: soft_pin semantics need to be explicit. runtime behaviour: prefer pinned model for `priority` fraction of requests or until `grace_seconds` expires, but allow fallback if pinned variant lacks capacity. Also we should include `min_serve_ratio` so clients can opt-in to stricter enforcement.
Maria Chen: agree, propose adding `min_serve_ratio` to soft_pin (default null). Example: `soft_pin: {priority:0.8, grace_seconds:600, min_serve_ratio:0.5}` means prefer pinned model but if it serves <50% due to capacity, fallback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for cohort canary-42 (deployment id d-2026-03-21-01) :eyes:
AJ Patel: we should version the schema (you already did `rollout_metadata_version:v1`) — +1. Also, make fields additive and nullable so older clients ignore them.
Samir Gupta: telemetry: emit `pin.decision` events with reason codes (e.g., `pinned`, `fallback_capacity`, `fallback_compat`) and include `cohort_label` + `rollout_metadata_version`. makes postmortems way easier.
Maria Chen: plan: create PR adding schema v1, keep fields optional, add DB index proposal and backfill plan (default null soft_pin). I'll include telemetry events and unit tests for decision paths.
Leo Park: one more edgecase: overlapping cohorts (two soft_pins for same tenant with different priorities). need deterministic tie-breaker: tenant-defined priority wins, else higher numeric priority, else older creation_ts. please add to PR.
Samir Gupta: +1 on tie-breaker. Also add a compact encoding for `compat_hints` so it doesn't blow up index keys.
AJ Patel: SGTM. please include an explicit migration window and a rollout plan for the index (online rebuild notes). :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: thanks — will open the PR and schedule a 20m sync tomorrow. will include docs snippet and a short test harness for runtime behaviour. :rocket:
